cards.text: Friend, God's people are split into two kingdoms, Judah and Israel (1 Kings 12:19-20). In Asa's second year as king of Judah, Nadab son of Jeroboam becomes king of Israel and reigns two years. His dad Jeroboam was the first king of this kingdom of Israel, and he made two golden calves and set them up in Bethel and Dan (1 Kings 12:20, 28-29).

cards.question: True or false: King Nadab breaks from his father Jeroboam's sin and does what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

cards.text: Nadab only gets two years, friend, and I've had oven mitts longer than that! At one point he and all Israel are laying siege to Gibbethon, a city of the Philistines, and in the picture is a man named Baasha, from the house of Issachar.

cards.question: While Israel besieges Gibbethon, what does Baasha do to King Nadab?

answers.text: He kills Nadab and reigns in his place
He fights bravely at Nadab's side
He warns Nadab of a Philistine trap

cards.text: As soon as Baasha becomes king, he turns his attention to what's left of Jeroboam's household.

cards.question: When King Baasha strikes down Jeroboam's household, how many of them does he leave alive?
Baasha's purge of Jeroboam's house happens according to a word the LORD had spoken earlier. Through which prophet?

cards.text: It happens because of the sins Jeroboam committed and caused Israel to commit, and because he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
Now Baasha reigns over all Israel from Tirzah for twenty-four years, and he and Asa of Judah are at war throughout their days.

Jeroboam's house just fell for his sins, and Baasha walks right into the SAME way of Jeroboam. Friend, that's like taking over for the guy who kept hitting snooze, then sleeping through your first day.

cards.question: Then the word of the LORD comes to the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against King Baasha. What does God remind Baasha He did for him?

answers.text: He raised him from nothing to be ruler
He helped him win his wars with Asa
He gave him the city of Gibbethon

cards.text: God says He lifted Baasha out of the dust, and still Baasha walked in the way of Jeroboam and caused Israel to sin. Friend, I spent YEARS in the dust of a junk drawer, and when somebody lifts you out of the dust, you do NOT go roll back in it!

cards.question: God says He will consume Baasha and his house, and make his house like the house of ___.

cards.text: Then a hard word: anyone of Baasha's who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field by the birds of the air, nearly the same warning Jeroboam's house got (1 Kings 14:11). The rest of Baasha's acts, his accomplishments and his might, are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.

cards.question: Baasha rests with his fathers and is buried in ___, and his son ___ reigns in his place.
The text sums up why the LORD's word through Jehu came against Baasha and his house. True or false: One reason it gives is that Baasha struck down the house of Jeroboam.

cards.text: Baasha's son Elah becomes king and reigns in Tirzah two years. And there he is in Tirzah, getting drunk at the house of Arza, the steward of his household.

cards.question: While King Elah is getting drunk at Arza's house, who conspires against him?

answers.text: Zimri commander of half his chariots
Arza the steward of his household
Jehu the prophet son of Hanani

cards.text: Zimri goes in, strikes Elah down and reigns in his place. Friend, that's like zoning out at the office party while your coworker is measuring your office for curtains.

cards.question: Once Zimri is seated on the throne, what does he do to Baasha's household?

answers.text: He sends them away to Judah
He gives them places at court

cards.question: Zimri destroys Baasha's household according to the word the LORD spoke against Baasha through ___ the prophet.
True or false: The text says Baasha's household falls because of Baasha's sins alone, not his son Elah's.

cards.text: Elah's acts go into the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel too. That's four kings and two wiped-out royal families already, friend, and Israel's throne is a revolving door that is SPINNING.
It's the twenty-seventh year of Asa's reign over Judah, and Zimri now sits on Israel's throne in Tirzah. Don't get too comfortable with this one, friend.

cards.question: Zimri reigns in Tirzah for ___ days.

cards.text: SEVEN DAYS, friend, that's not a reign, that's a free trial! Meanwhile Israel's troops are camped against Gibbethon of the Philistines, and word reaches the camp that Zimri conspired against the king and struck him down.

cards.question: When the troops at Gibbethon hear what Zimri did, what do they do there in the camp that very day?

answers.text: Proclaim Omri the army commander king
Swear their loyalty to King Zimri
Go home to their own tribes

cards.text: Omri and all the Israelites march up from Gibbethon and besiege Tirzah, where Zimri is.

cards.question: When Zimri sees that Tirzah is captured, what does he do?

answers.text: Burns the palace citadel down on himself
Flees south to King Asa in Judah
Surrenders the city to Omri's army

cards.text: So Zimri dies because of the sins he committed, following the example of Jeroboam. His treason goes into the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.

cards.question: Then Israel splits right down the middle: half the people back Tibni son of Ginath as king, and half back Omri. How does it end?

answers.text: Omri's side wins and he becomes king
Tibni and Omri share the throne
Tibni's side wins and Omri flees

cards.text: In the thirty-first year of Asa's reign, Omri becomes king of Israel and reigns twelve years, six of them in Tirzah. He buys a hill from a man named Shemer for two talents of silver and builds a city there.

cards.question: Omri names his new city ___ after Shemer, who had owned the hill.
Omri has a brand new city. True or false: Omri acts more wickedly in the sight of the LORD than all who were before him.

cards.text: Omri walks in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, provoking the LORD with worthless idols. Then he rests with his fathers, is buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab reigns in his place.
In the thirty-eighth year of Asa's reign over Judah, Omri's son Ahab becomes king of Israel. He reigns in Samaria twenty-two years, so friend, this one is NOT a free trial.

cards.question: How does King Ahab do in the sight of the LORD compared to all who were before him?

answers.text: He does more evil than all of them
He does better than his father did
He does right like King Asa did

cards.text: And as if it were not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam, Ahab marries Jezebel, the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians.

cards.question: After marrying Jezebel, who does Ahab go on to serve and worship?
Ahab sets up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal he built in ___.
After the altar for Baal, what does Ahab set up next?

cards.text: So Ahab does more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel before him. Friend, his dad set the bar, and Ahab basically said, hold my apron.
One more thing happens in Ahab's days: Hiel from Bethel rebuilds Jericho.

cards.question: What does rebuilding Jericho cost Hiel?

answers.text: His firstborn son and his youngest son
All the silver and gold he owned
His house and his fields in Bethel

cards.question: True or false: What happens to Hiel's sons is according to the word the LORD spoke through Joshua son of Nun.
